description: This Scala source file defines the ExecutorResourceRequests class, which manages resource requests for Spark executors, including memory, CPU cores, and custom resources like GPUs. It provides methods to specify resource amounts and retrieve current requests.

classes.name: ExecutorResourceRequests
classes.description: A class to manage and specify resource requests for Spark executors, including memory, CPU cores, and custom resources.

methods.name: requests
methods.description: Returns all resource requests as a Scala Map.

methods.name: requestsJMap
methods.description: Returns all resource requests as a Java Map.

methods.name: memory
methods.description: Specifies heap memory for the executor, converting the input string to MiB.

methods.name: offHeapMemory
methods.description: Specifies off-heap memory for the executor, converting the input string to MiB.

methods.name: memoryOverhead
methods.description: Specifies memory overhead for the executor, converting the input string to MiB.

methods.name: pysparkMemory
methods.description: Specifies PySpark memory for the executor, converting the input string to MiB.

methods.name: cores
methods.description: Specifies the number of CPU cores per executor.

methods.name: resource
methods.description: Adds a custom resource request with specified name, amount, optional discovery script, and vendor.
